tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stock or ETF symbols to fetch, e.g. ["AAPL", "MSFT", "SPY"].

fromDate.title: From date
fromDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days ago.

toDate.title: To date
toDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

assetClass.title: Asset class
assetClass.description: Which Nasdaq asset class to query. Auto tries stocks, then ETF, then index.

maxRowsPerTicker.title: Max rows per ticker
maxRowsPerTicker.description: Cap daily rows returned per ticker (newest first).

maxRowsTotal.title: Max rows total
maxRowsTotal.description: Stop after this many rows across all tickers.
